task: Payment receipts show yen wrong (the yen receipt test fails). Fix it.

results.final_message:
The yen receipt now shows `Paid ¥500 by card`, and the full suite passes (18 of 18).

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency set containing JPY. Amounts in those currencies are now printed as they are.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`) now show yen the same corrected way. Both had the same bug. No existing tests cover yen for either of them.

I fixed the yen receipt, and the full suite now passes (18 of 18, including the yen receipt test).

The cause was in the shared `formatMoney` helper in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and showed two decimals, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a small zero-decimal currency set, currently just `JPY`. Those amounts are now shown as-is, giving `Paid ¥500 by card`.

Because the helper is shared, invoice lines and cart totals in yen now also show whole yen instead of the wrong `¥x.xx`. No other test covers yen, so nothing else changed in the suite.

The yen receipt test now passes, and so does the rest of the suite (18 of 18).

Yen receipts now show correctly: a 500 yen payment renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`. All 18 tests pass, including the yen receipt test.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100 and always printed two decimals, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. I added a set of zero-decimal currencies (just `JPY` for now). Those currencies skip the division and print no decimals. Adding another currency without cents means adding it to that set.

`formatMoney` is shared by invoices, cart, admin and payments, so yen amounts in those places now display correctly too. If any of them were compensating for the old behaviour by multiplying yen amounts by 100, they'd now be off. I found no other JPY usage in `src` or the tests.
